description:
Everyday Riding for Neighborhood Trails and Daily Recreation

Whether you're riding through the neighborhood, exploring local parks, or taking a weekend ride on paved paths and light dirt trails, the Traveler 21-Speed Mountain Bike is designed to provide a comfortable and confidence-inspiring ride for beginners and recreational cyclists.
Its lightweight aluminum frame keeps the bike responsive without adding unnecessary weight, while the front suspension fork helps smooth rough pavement and uneven paths. Combined with a Shimano 21-speed drivetrain, the Traveler gives riders the flexibility to handle a variety of everyday riding conditions.
Designed as an entry-level mountain bike, the Traveler is well suited for recreational riding, bike paths, gravel paths, and light off-road trails.

Shimano 21-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 21-speed drivetrain provides a wide gear range for climbing gentle hills, riding on flat roads, and adapting to changing terrain.
Shimano EZ-FIRE PLUS shifters make gear changes simple and intuitive, allowing newer riders to shift confidently while providing dependable performance for experienced cyclists.

Lightweight Aluminum Frame
The lightweight aluminum frame offers an excellent balance of durability, efficiency, and corrosion resistance.
Its responsive handling makes the Traveler easy to control while remaining comfortable for everyday riding and recreational adventures.

Front Suspension for Added Comfort
Road cracks, gravel paths, tree roots, and uneven pavement are common during recreational rides.
The suspension fork helps absorb these impacts, improving comfort and maintaining better front-wheel control on light trails and mixed surfaces.

Reliable Tektro V-Brakes
Front and rear Tektro alloy V-brakes provide dependable stopping performance with straightforward maintenance.
Whether riding through a park, descending a neighborhood hill, or navigating everyday traffic, the braking system delivers predictable control.

26-Inch Wheels Built for Recreational Riding
The 26-inch wheels offer responsive handling and confident maneuverability, making them well suited for recreational mountain biking and casual trail riding.
The 26 × 1.95-inch tires provide a practical balance of rolling efficiency, traction, and durability across pavement, gravel, and light dirt trails.

Ideal For
The Traveler is an excellent choice for riders looking for one bike that can comfortably handle:

The Traveler is designed for recreational riding and light off-road use. It is not intended for technical mountain bike trails, aggressive downhill riding, jumps, or extreme terrain.
